schema_note: Each number has: value, status (known|estimate), confidence for estimates, source, note. kind: llm|speech|image|video|forecast|utility, sets the base shape. realtime: streaming model. layers: floors from bottom to top; part: encoder|decoder; mixer: mamba|attention. annexes: parts outside the layers (embeddings, text_encoder, vae, codec). loop: {passes, max}, a recurrent core whose floors are passed several times. retrain: the model this one was post-trained from.
